verdict.rationale: Klaviyo publishes an llms.txt at www.klaviyo.com/llms.txt that points agents to headless access through its public APIs and MCP server, and it documents an MCP server for agent clients like Claude and Cursor. The 404 at developers.klaviyo.com/llms.txt is a different host, so it does not contradict the root llms.txt, but it does show the developer docs lack their own agent-oriented index. Missing for 10: an llms.txt (or llms-full.txt) covering the developer/API reference docs, evidence the llms.txt content goes beyond product/portfolio overview, and independent hands-on corroboration of agents consuming it.
